name: vinskills
description: Lashvin Manimaran's Claude Code skills: media, robotics and AI evaluation, plus the vin-core workflow plugin.

plugins.name: vin-core
plugins.description: House workflow and context tools: build and ship with agents, web QA, token and cost lens, symbol navigation, documents to Markdown, output squeezing, scripts over big JSON.

plugins.name: vin-media
plugins.description: Make videos, podcasts, dubs, voiced websites, talking avatars, courses, share cards and release notes on your own machine. Installs: reel-studio, podcast-studio, dub-studio, site-narrator, avatar-studio, talking-head, course-studio, share-cards, changelog-studio.

plugins.name: vin-robotics
plugins.description: Check, view, animate, simulate, replay and film robot models (URDF), make AR files and scan objects into 3D. Installs: urdf-doctor, robot-viewer, retarget-studio, physics-studio, replay-studio, robot-reel, ar-models, scan-studio.

plugins.name: vin-ai-eval
plugins.description: Test chatbots and agents like software, benchmark a local voice assistant, replay agent sessions and lint skill repos. Installs: eval-studio, voice-loop, trace-studio, skill-ci.

plugins.name: reel-studio
plugins.description: Short voiced motion-graphics videos from a text script, made entirely on your own machine.

plugins.name: podcast-studio
plugins.description: Two-voice podcast episodes made on your own machine from an article or script: voices, mix, chapters, captions, show notes and an audiogram video.

plugins.name: dub-studio
plugins.description: Translate and re-voice a video locally with synthetic voices, keeping the music, with bilingual subtitles.

plugins.name: site-narrator
plugins.description: Give any website a recorded voice with no paid service: record its text locally and play it in the browser.

plugins.name: avatar-studio
plugins.description: Turn a drawn portrait and a script into a video of that character speaking it, made locally and labelled as computer-generated.

plugins.name: talking-head
plugins.description: Turn one illustrated portrait into a 3D head for a web page that follows the pointer, blinks and talks.

plugins.name: course-studio
plugins.description: Turn your documents into a static interactive course site: cited lessons read aloud, quizzes with proof, glossary, search and progress.

plugins.name: share-cards
plugins.description: Link-preview images and per-page share tags for every page of a website, from one HTML template.

plugins.name: changelog-studio
plugins.description: A git range becomes checked release notes, a CHANGELOG section, a 30-second release reel and a share card.

plugins.name: urdf-doctor
plugins.description: Audit and repair URDF robot models, export MJCF, test them in MuJoCo, with a visual 3D report.

plugins.name: robot-viewer
plugins.description: Turn a URDF robot into one compressed GLB and an embeddable, CSP-safe <robot-viewer> web component.

plugins.name: retarget-studio
plugins.description: Retarget human motion capture (BVH) onto a URDF robot within its limits, with a side-by-side video.

plugins.name: physics-studio
plugins.description: A robot plus a plain-language task becomes a narrated MuJoCo physics clip with force overlays and a run log.

plugins.name: replay-studio
plugins.description: One robot recording (rosbag, MCAP, LeRobot, CSV) becomes a synced replay video and a scrubbable offline viewer.

plugins.name: robot-reel
plugins.description: Turn a robot description (URDF) and a shot list into a voiced showcase video of the robot, made locally.

plugins.name: ar-models
plugins.description: Turn 3D models and robot files into AR files phones can place in the room: GLB for Android, USDZ for iPhone.

plugins.name: scan-studio
plugins.description: A phone video or photo set of an object becomes a 3D model (GLB, optional USDZ) and a report, CPU only. Objects only; captures with detected faces are refused.

plugins.name: eval-studio
plugins.description: Test chatbots, RAG systems and agents like software: run cases, score answers, compare with the last run, gate CI and read a report.

plugins.name: voice-loop
plugins.description: Build and benchmark a local voice assistant (VAD, Whisper, any OpenAI-compatible LLM, Kokoro) with per-stage latency.

plugins.name: trace-studio
plugins.description: Turn an AI agent session into an anonymised replay page and a short narrated summary video.

plugins.name: skill-ci
plugins.description: GitHub Action and CLI that checks Claude Code skill repos: SKILL.md lint, secrets scan, script safety, media budget.
